findings.title: orbit-conventions baseline Purpose (L5) still names old `Distribution model — overlay, not CLI fork` verbatim
findings.details: Baseline Purpose enumerates 'the **distribution model** (overlay, not CLI fork)' — verbatim the OLD requirement title this change RENAMES. The delta has no Purpose-section edit; after archive sync the renamed Requirement title and the Purpose summary will textually disagree (OpenSpec archive-sync only updates Requirements blocks, not Purpose prose). Analogous to but distinct from the known stale `/opsx:sync-specs deprecated` bullet in orbit-run-summary-emit baseline that IS deliberately documented as known-issue in design.md item 4. This Purpose-line drift was not flagged in any prior review iteration and isn't in design.md's documented-known-issues list.
findings.recommendation: Either (a) add to design.md item 4 'Baseline-language drift deferred' a second bullet calling out `orbit-conventions/spec.md:5 Purpose summary` as a sibling known-issue, OR (b) add a small task 1.4 fixing it inline (parallel to task 1.3 which fixes baseline prose at archive-summary-schema.md:18). Option (b) is the cleaner parallel.
